summary: Reply window freezes after attempting to modify text color
description:
User Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/88.0.4321.0 Safari/537.36 Edg/88.0.702.0

Steps to reproduce:

1. From an open message window or the message preview pane, clicked "Reply All"
2. In the reply window, selected text to highlight
3(attempt a). Clicked on font color icon(?)
3(attempt b). From menu, clicked Format > Text Color...

Actual results:

Reply window locks up, and everything in the window becomes completely unresponsive, including not being able to close the window, but the window can be moved on the screen.  From the color scheme, it appears that the window is stuck in Inactive mode. 

Pressing ALT-F4 does not close the window, but does appear to change it to Active, after which it can be closed normally.  Attempting to change font color again locks it up again.

Main Thunderbird window can still be closed normally.

Expected results:

Clicking on anything to change colors should bring up color choice window.
